question: What mantra form results when the same addition is made in the Śakti seed?
premises: The same procedure is applied in the context of the Śakti bīja.
The resulting form is called Lopā.
This form consists of seventeen syllables.
inference: Applying the same addition in the Śakti bīja yields the seventeen-syllabled Lopā mantra.
plain_english: In the same way, when applied in the Śakti seed, the Lopā mantra becomes seventeen-syllabled.
